bmt-2015-analysis-tiebreaker-03.title: Squeeze
bmt-2015-analysis-tiebreaker-03.body:
Let $M=\max_i|a_i|$ and assume $M>0$. Along even $n$ (or if all $a_i\ge0$ for every $n$), $\frac{M^n}{k}\le\frac{\sum a_i^n}{k}\le M^n$, so the $n$th root lies between $M\,k^{-1/n}$ and $M$, and both bounds tend to $M$. If all $a_i=0$ the limit is $0$.

So the limit is $\max_i|a_i|$. (For odd $n$ with negative terms the sum can be negative or cancel, and the limit need not exist; the intended reading is $\max a_i$ for non-negative $a_i$, i.e. $\max_i|a_i|$.)

**Answer: $\max_i|a_i|$**
